institutionName: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was my professor who send me the possibility, so it was because of the course that I went to Napoli, but it was a bonus that the weather and food is great there.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I send a motivational letter to my professor

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Here it was a lot of lectures and lab work and we went on a trip to Capri to do sampling where as UCPH a lot of the time you do the work alone and prepare for lectures and classes

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Find a central place to live, enjoy the food and the weather.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: enjoy and find something that interests you as you have long days about the topic.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: it was very inspiring to hear from PhD students and master students about their projects.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: the administrative work before going. getting the OLA signed and "forhåndsgodkendelse".

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Patrizia Contursi and Carmen Arena did such a good job. I think this was one of my best experiences ever.
